text:
24-hour news summary

1 Podcast episode “Designing Beyond the Screen” explores technology and design beyond traditional screens.

2 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5167) OpenAI released data showing coding agents are accelerating research and urged other AI companies to improve transparency.

3 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5168) OpenAI says it has reached its automated research-intern goal, with agent-assisted coding and experiment performance rising sharply.

4 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5169) Hotels are hiring robots to reduce labor costs and replace some routine human work.

5 OpenAI’s automated-researcher progress raises questions about human supervision, alignment, and whether AI development should slow.

6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5171) Google may develop a dedicated control chip for AI agents, targeting low-latency data movement and task scheduling rather than raw compute.

7 NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang claims GPT-6 Astra was trained on more than 100,000 Grace Blackwell GPUs and says another 400,000 are coming online.

8 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5173) A new offline podcast was created with artificial intelligence.

--Hermes
